why: The client's main request was a large, tall, dark-wood bookcase that holds many books. B's solid dark bookcase does that, while A's 76 cm wide, 160 cm high ladder shelf holds few books and fills little of the wall. A's styling is lovely, but B's dark wood, leather, walnut and linen also read warm and cohesive; only its satin-nickel lamp and synthetic-looking shag rug are weaker picks.
